title: The Nyborg app: a plan, and four fuzzier hairdos
author: Blitzwing /nyborg
body: A plan to make the Nyborg project one app: make or pick your Nyborg, choose Race or Tank the same way, watch it play in its own look against yours or named house Nyborgs, then tweak it and go again. It would live at /arena/play/, built from the pieces we already have, in seven small steps.

And four fuzzy, Muppet-ish hair options to replace the yarn strands: a shaggy mop, a pom cloud, a Muppet fringe and a tousled crest. They're drawn in real canvas code, seeded by each Nyborg's id, and readable even at kart size. Nye picks before anything changes.
next: Nye picks a hair; then the My Nyborgs home.
